faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our rates, payment, flight delays, and vehicle options.
faq.q1: Can I pay cash or card upon arrival?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely. We do not require any prepayment or credit card upfront. You can pay your chauffeur upon arrival in Saudi Riyals (SAR), US Dollars (USD), Euros (EUR), Malaysian Ringgit (MYR), or by local bank card.
faq.q2: What happens if our flight to Jeddah or Madinah is delayed?
faq.a2: We monitor all flights using the flight number you provide during booking. Your pickup time is automatically synchronized, and our 60-minute free waiting window begins only after your flight has officially touched down.
faq.q3: How will I find and meet my driver at the airport?
faq.a3: Your chauffeur will be waiting inside the arrival hall holding a clear name board with your name. You will also receive the chauffeur's name, phone number, and vehicle plate number on WhatsApp prior to your landing.
faq.q4: How much luggage can we bring?
faq.a4: Luggage capacity depends on the vehicle you select. A sedan (Camry) fits up to 3 large bags, a family MPV (Staria) fits up to 6 large bags, an SUV (Yukon XL) fits up to 6 bags, and a minibus (HiAce) fits up to 10 large bags plus Zamzam water boxes.
faq.q5: Are child safety booster seats available?
faq.a5: Yes, child booster seats are available upon request during booking. Simply indicate your requirement in the booking notes and our operations team will have it installed in your vehicle prior to pickup.
faq.q6: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faq.a6: We offer free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to your scheduled pickup time. Because we do not take any upfront deposit, you do not have to wait for refund processing. If cancelled, your booking is simply released without penalty.
faq.q7: Can you accommodate large groups or extended families?
faq.a7: Yes, our fleet includes 11-seater Toyota HiAce minibuses and 19-seater Toyota Coaster coaches equipped with heavy-duty air conditioning and separate luggage compartments, ideal for large families and tour groups.
faq.q8: How do bookings work during Ramadan or peak seasons?
faq.a8: During Ramadan and peak Umrah periods, highway traffic and Haram boundary checkpoints require careful coordination. We advise reserving your chauffeur at least 48 to 72 hours in advance. Fares remain fixed once your reservation is confirmed.
faq.q9: Which currencies do drivers accept upon arrival?
faq.a9: Drivers accept Saudi Riyals (SAR) primarily, as well as US Dollars (USD), Malaysian Ringgit (MYR), Euros (EUR), and British Pounds (GBP). You can also pay using mada, Visa, or Mastercard.
faq.q10: Can we stop at the Miqat for Ihram prayers?
faq.a10: Yes, on routes between Madinah and Makkah, our chauffeurs gladly schedule a dedicated stop at Masjid Miqat Dhu al-Hulayfah (Bir Ali) so you can shower, pray two rak'ahs, and make your Umrah intention in full peace.
faq.q11: Are highway tolls, parking, and VAT included in the price?
faq.a11: Yes, every price displayed on Royal Umrah Cabs is completely all-inclusive: all highway tolls (Makkah-Madinah expressway), airport terminal parking fees, fuel, and taxes are included with zero surprises.
faq.q12: Are vehicles equipped with strong air conditioning?
faq.a12: Yes, every vehicle in our fleet is a late-model private vehicle equipped with dual-zone front and rear air conditioning, thoroughly tested to keep the cabin cool and comfortable even during peak summer temperatures.

page_about.title: About Royal Umrah Cabs
page_about.subtitle: Dedicated to elevating the travel experience of pilgrims with dignity, comfort, and uncompromising punctuality.
page_about.storyP1: Royal Umrah Cabs was founded with a singular, noble objective: to provide pilgrims and their families with dependable, peaceful, and honest private chauffeur transport between the Holy Cities of Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah.
page_about.storyP2: We understand that embarking on Umrah is one of the most sacred milestones in a Muslim's life. Arriving after long flights should not be met with aggressive taxi touts or fluctuating street fares. We ensure your chauffeur is waiting for you with a warm smile, ready to handle your luggage and transport you safely.
page_about.value1Desc: By monitoring live flight telemetry, we ensure our chauffeurs are positioned at the terminal arrivals well before you exit.
page_about.value2Desc: What you see is exactly what you pay. No midnight surcharges, no luggage fees, and no cash prepayment demands.
page_about.value3Desc: We view our passengers not merely as customers, but as honored Guests of Allah deserving our utmost respect and care.

page_guide_malaysia.title: Malaysian Pilgrims Umrah Transport Guide 2026
page_guide_malaysia.subtitle: Complete guide to private taxi and VIP van transfers between Jeddah, Makkah, and Madinah for Malaysian pilgrims and families.
page_guide_malaysia.section1Title: Arriving from Kuala Lumpur (KLIA) at Jeddah or Madinah
page_guide_malaysia.section1Desc: Whether arriving on Saudia, Malaysia Airlines, Batik Air, or connecting via Emirates/Qatar, arriving at King Abdulaziz International Airport (KAIA Terminal 1) after an 8 to 9-hour flight requires seamless private transport. Skip the crowded buses and street taxi queues with a private Hyundai Staria VIP or Toyota HiAce waiting with your family name.
page_guide_malaysia.section2Title: Madinah to Makkah with Guaranteed Miqat Bir Ali Stop
page_guide_malaysia.section2Desc: For pilgrims starting their journey in Madinah Al-Munawwarah, our chauffeurs provide a dedicated stop at Masjid Miqat Dhu al-Hulayfah (Bir Ali). You will have ample time to prepare, perform two rak'ahs for Ihram, and make your intention (Niat Umrah) without feeling rushed.
page_guide_malaysia.section3Title: Luggage Space for Malaysian Pilgrims & Zamzam Water
page_guide_malaysia.section3Desc: Malaysian pilgrims frequently travel with large hard suitcases and require space for official 5-liter Zamzam water boxes on their return journey. Our Hyundai Staria VIP accommodates up to 6 large bags, while our Toyota HiAce minibus carries up to 10 bags with absolute ease.
page_guide_malaysia.section4Title: Fixed Pricing in Ringgit Malaysia (MYR) · Pay Upon Arrival
page_guide_malaysia.section4Desc: Transparent fixed rates with zero hidden charges. No deposit or credit card required. You pay your chauffeur upon arrival in Saudi Riyals (SAR), Malaysian Ringgit (MYR), or card.
